releases.title: Smarter Search & Better Exports
releases.summary: Find information in your documents faster with improved search, plus better PDF support for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text.

items: Upload data files and let AI analyze them for you
See how much AI usage you've consumed in each conversation
Mark important files as favorites for quick access
Add summaries to files to remember what they contain
New legal case search tool for legal professionals
Search now finds more relevant results in your Knowledge Base
Better support for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text in PDF exports
Faster document processing when uploading multiple files
PDF exports now correctly display Asian language fonts
Search results are more accurate and consistent

releases.title: Welcome to doXmind Beta
releases.summary: The first public release of doXmind - your AI-powered writing assistant that helps you write better, faster.

items: Rich text editor with Markdown support and live preview
AI Chat - ask questions, get writing help, brainstorm ideas
Smart Autocomplete - AI suggests text as you type, press Tab to accept
Knowledge Base - upload PDFs and documents, then ask AI questions about them
Version History - track changes and restore previous versions anytime
Works on mobile with voice-to-text input
Export to PDF and Word formats
